subject.title: Add plan-first Claw status and remove

question: Should experimental `claws remove` expose explicit referenced-artifact deletion and force-override controls, or should removal remain limited to releasing references and safely removing only conclusively Claw-owned, unused workspace skills?
rationale: The correct boundary for deleting shared plugins and adopted or referenced artifacts is a durable lifecycle-policy choice, not a mechanical correctness decision.

options.title: Approve retain-by-default overrides
options.body: Keep the proposed explicit cleanup controls, but require exact-head proof that shared, adopted, and conflicting artifacts are retained unless the consented selector and override are present.

options.title: Narrow removal scope
options.body: Remove referenced-artifact and force-override controls from this slice, leaving removal to release references and uninstall only conclusively sole-owned workspace skills.

recommendation.title: Approve retain-by-default overrides
recommendation.body: Keep the proposed explicit cleanup controls, but require exact-head proof that shared, adopted, and conflicting artifacts are retained unless the consented selector and override are present.

likelyOwner.reason: Their review comment directly frames the lifecycle authority, downstream deletion, and shared-resource policy that this decision resolves.
